keySentence: The best trick is making hard work feel like play.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: We finished all the G4 stories. We learned many lessons. Make hard work fun. The best trick is making hard work feel like play.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Congratulations on finishing all the Grade 4 English stories. From Wind in the Willows to Tom Sawyer, we learned so much. Every story taught us about courage, love, and seeing differently. The best trick is making hard work feel like play every day. Tom Sawyer showed us that attitude can change everything. Keep learning English with joy, just like playing a wonderful game.
facts.Word cards: best trick = 최고의 비결 / feel like play = 놀이처럼 느끼다 / hard work = 열심히 하기 / wonderful = 훌륭한

choice: best trick or feel like play?
